    SnacksJump Man arcade garlic knotsGiuseppe on the Jump Man cabinet. Garlic butter knots and marinara.How to make it500g ready-made pizza dough60g butter, melted3 garlic cloves, crushed2 tbsp parsley, chopped40g parmesan, finely grated250ml marinara sauceRoll the dough into 12 ropes and tie each one in a loose knot.Bake on a lined tray at 220°C until golden.Stir the garlic and parsley into the melted butter and brush it over the hot knots.Scatter with parmesan and serve with the warmed marinara.Fire Flower aranciniPeach's Fire Flower power-up. Mozzarella risotto balls and spicy tomato.How to make it30g butter1 brown onion, finely diced300g arborio rice1 L vegetable stock50g parmesan, grated100g mozzarella, cut in small cubes75g plain flour2 eggs, beaten120g dried breadcrumbs1 L vegetable oil, for frying250ml passata1/2 tsp chilli flakesSoften the onion in the butter, stir in the rice, then add the hot stock a ladle at a time until creamy and tender.Stir in the parmesan, spread on a tray and cool completely.Roll into balls around a cube of mozzarella, then coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.Fry in oil at 180°C until deep golden.Simmer the passata with the chilli and serve as a dip.Warp Pipe breadsticksBrooklyn sewer to Mushroom Kingdom.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsRed and green pepper Brooklyn pizzaThe brothers' usual at Punch-Out. Red peppers one half and green the other.How to make it2 x 250g balls of pizza dough250ml pizza sauce300g mozzarella, grated1 red capsicum, sliced1 green capsicum, sliced1 tsp dried oregano1 cup basil leaves2 tbsp olive oilHeat the oven as hot as it goes with a tray inside.Stretch the dough into 2 large rounds and spread with sauce.Scatter with mozzarella, then red capsicum on one half and green on the other, and the oregano.Bake on the hot tray until blistered and bubbling.Finish with basil and a drizzle of oil.Foreman Spike's meatball heroesSpike calls them Brooklyn's favourite failures. Meatballs, marinara and provolone.How to make it500g beef mince60g fresh breadcrumbs1 egg30g parmesan, grated2 garlic cloves, crushed700ml passata1 tsp dried oregano4 long crusty rolls8 slices of provolone1 cup basil leavesMix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan and half the garlic and roll into 16 balls.Brown the meatballs in a hot pan, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic and simmer until cooked through.Split the rolls, pile in the meatballs and sauce and lay over the provolone.Grill until the cheese melts, then add basil and serve.TreatsBlue Mini Mushroom cupcakesPeach feeds Bowser the Mini Mushroom. Blue icing and white chocolate spots.How to make it150g soft butter, plus 125g for the icing150g caster sugar3 eggs175g self-raising flour60ml milk1 tsp vanilla extract250g icing sugar1/2 tsp blue food colouring gel50g white chocolate meltsBeat 150g butter and the sugar until pale, then beat in the eggs one at a time.Fold in the flour, milk and vanilla and spoon into 12 lined cupcake cases.Bake at 180°C until springy, then cool.Beat the rest of the butter with the icing sugar and blue colouring, then dome it on each cupcake.Press on white chocolate melts for the mushroom spots.DrinksBowser's Peaches iced teaBowser sings Peaches. Peach iced tea, lemon and mint.How to make it4 black tea bags1 L boiling water400ml peach nectar2 tbsp honey1 lemon, sliced1/2 cup mint leaves2 cups ice cubesSteep the tea bags in the boiling water, then stir in the honey and cool.Mix the cold tea with the peach nectar.Pour over ice with lemon slices and mint.Rainbow Road sodaMind the blue shells.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
